segments.name: Digital Asset Tokens
segments.description: Provides RWA tokenization, securities brokerage and transaction services, asset management and consultancy to clients trading tokenized products on chains.
segments.evidence: the Company has reorganized its business segments which now consist of two reportable segments: (i) Digital Asset Tokens, and (ii) AI Tokens ("Segment Reorganization").

segments.name: AI Tokens
segments.description: Provides enterprise customers with end-to-end cloud and digital application solutions through an integrated service model.
segments.evidence: introduced a new segment, "AI Tokens" containing "AI infrastructure service fee".

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fees for tokenization projects, securities transactions, asset management, consultancy and AI infrastructure services, including related party clients.
revenueModel.evidence: Provides an integrated service model that provides enterprise customers with end-to-end cloud and digital application solutions.

changes.text: In 2026 the Company reorganized its business segments, which now consist of two reportable segments, Digital Asset Tokens and AI Tokens.
